content: Tailscale device sharing: share specific machine with external user via Machine page → Share → email or link invite (30 day expiry, single-use or reusable). Recipient needs a Tailscale account. Shared machines are quarantined: can respond to incoming connections but cannot initiate. ACL/grants: autogroup:shared targets all accepted-invite users. Example grant: {src: [autogroup:shared], dst: [*], ip: [port]}. Tag recommendation: tag:agenthub for machine grouping. Grants preferred over ACLs (ACLs won't get new features). Wildcard-default gotcha: old ACL wildcard (*→*) includes autogroup:shared; with grants, it's deny-by-default requiring explicit grant.
